# dsh-mcp-servers — MCP servers settings page
English | 中文
> A profile-config settings page for DeepSeek Harness that lets you manage MCP servers from the Web
UI and mounts live `mcp-client` instances from the saved list.
Each server you add becomes a running MCP client whose tools are registered on the agent tool regist
ry, so the model can call them the moment you save — no restart, no hand-edited YAML. The page is a
JSON editor over the `mcp-servers` profile-config namespace; the Host half owns the schema and the l
ive bridge, the browser half owns the editor card.
## Features
| Feature | Description |

| Settings page | A first-level Settings section `MCP 服务器` with an add/edit/remove card list |
| JSO

N editor | Edit the whole `servers` array in one textarea; add a server with one click |
| Live brid
ge | The Host mounts one `mcp-client` instance per enabled server and re-syncs on every settings edi

t (`loader/volatile-update`) without remounting the plugin |
| stdio + streamable-http | Each server

carries `name`, `command`, `args`, `env`, `transport`, `url`, `enabled` |
| Profile-config backed |
Values persist to the active profile's plugin config; the page reads/writes through the shared `con
figForms` namespace |
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- **Namespace**: `mcp-servers`. The owning profile entry id must equal this string; the plugin's Con

fig schema IS the namespace under the profile-config settings model.
- **Live edits**: `servers` is
declared `.volatile()`, so the settings model exposes the namespace and edits do not remount the plu
gin. The Host reads the live value through `Volatile.get()` and re-syncs the bridge on `loader/volat

ile-update`.
- **Browser bundle**: rides the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` contract; React and `@de
epseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` resolve from the loader's module table (external); CSS Modules a
re inlined by lightningcss as `<style data-plugin>`.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
After installing, **restart `dsh web`**. Open Settings → MCP 服务器 to manage servers. In link mode, ru
n `pnpm build` and refresh the page after a code change; no reinstall needed.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The browser bundle is produced with the harness `clientBundle` helper; building from a fresh clone r
equires the DeepSeek Harness repository available (the `tsdown.config.ts` imports its `clientBundle`
). The shipped `lib/` is pre-built, so consumers never build.
